base: Use case: stylized-concept. Original MODULAR CHARACTER SPRITE LAYERS for Outpost, a top-down pixel-art zombie survival game. Transparent PNG with real alpha. Strict chunky tiny pixel art, underlying character only 18 pixels wide and 24 pixels tall, enlarged with crisp square edges. 1-pixel dark outlines, 3 flat grayscale shades per surface, NO antialiasing, no gradients, no texture noise. All pieces in neutral GRAYSCALE for runtime recoloring. Exactly FOUR evenly spaced columns: facing DOWN/front, facing RIGHT, facing UP/back, facing LEFT. Orthographic elevated top-down character perspective, compact big-head proportions. Generous transparent gutters; every isolated item fully visible. No text, labels, grid lines, ground, shadows, props, weapons. Exactly TWO rows of FOUR full adult character base bodies. Row1 male, row2 female. BALD heads with completely BLANK faces, NO eyes or hair. Rounded square head about 11 pixels tall, short torso about7 pixels, legs and bare feet about6 pixels. Relaxed straight arms at sides, symmetric planted feet. Skin LIGHT GRAY, plain DARK BLUE modest underwear (tank underlayer and shorts). No sexual anatomical detail. Both sexes share identical height, hand/foot positions, head anchor and proportions; female subtly narrower shoulders. These are adult chibi mannequin bases for layering shirts, trousers, shoes and hairstyles.
